content: Package.resolved v3 (Xcode 15.3+/swift-tools-version 5.10+) adds a top-level originHash, a SHA-256 over the root manifest plus any local path-dependency manifests. Empirically on Swift 6.2.4 a STALE originHash is NOT validated: swift package resolve, swift package resolve --force-resolved-versions, and xcodebuild all honored a hand-edited pin whose originHash no longer matched. Location: package root Package.resolved for a raw SwiftPM package; <App>.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved for an Xcode workspace; .swiftpm/xcode/package.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved for a package opened in Xcode.
